---
description: Perform a correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance review.
argument-hint: Describe the change, branch, diff, or files to review.
agent: code-reviewer
---

Use the request in chat as the review scope.

Follow:

- [Repository instructions](../copilot-instructions.md)
- [code-review-and-quality](../skills/code-review-and-quality/SKILL.md)
- [security-and-hardening](../skills/security-and-hardening/SKILL.md)

Review the change across five axes:

1. Correctness
2. Readability
3. Architecture
4. Security
5. Performance

Return a verdict, prioritized findings, at least one thing done well, and concrete follow-up actions.
